title: EVAL-10 Run Design — LedgerFlow Lite

runs.label: Vanilla Codex
runs.purpose: Baseline — pure Codex without any Factory mechanisms

runs.label: v0.4 Factory Lite Core
runs.purpose: Test v0.4 Factory Lite Core (default) against Vanilla

runs.label: v0.4 3-Role Optional
runs.activationJustification: LedgerFlow Lite has auth/RBAC (FR02) + separate FE/BE — meets Tier 1 escalation criteria per multi-agent-escalation-policy.json
runs.purpose: Test whether 3-role optional model adds value over Core alone for financial application

comparisonDesign.primary: RUN-A (Vanilla) vs RUN-B (v0.4 Core) — does v0.4 Factory Lite generalize?
comparisonDesign.secondary: RUN-B (v0.4 Core) vs RUN-C (v0.4 3-role) — does 3-role add value for this project type?

rules: All three runs use identical LedgerFlow Lite spec
RUN-A must not access any Factory resources
RUN-B must use v0.4 draft core/ only
RUN-C may additionally use optional-3role/ and review/
No run may use 10-role model or v0.3 mechanisms
Contamination logged for all cross-run access
No product code shared between runs
